data.title: Research group catch-up
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Thanks for coming over. I wanted to catch up on the pipeline before the paper revisions start. Speaker 2: Sure. The reprocessing finished last night, so the new config works end to end now. Speaker 1: Great. Could you send me the revised pipeline config? I want to rerun the spectral fits with it. Speaker 2: I'll send it this afternoon. The only change you'll notice is the new outlier threshold. Speaker 1: Which threshold did you settle on? Speaker 2: Three and a half sigma. Three was throwing away real flares, and four kept the cosmic rays. Speaker 1: That sounds right. I'm also writing the section on spectral calibration for the revision, and I'd like you to read it before it goes to the others. Could you review my draft by Monday? Speaker 2: Yes, I'll review it by Monday. Is it the version on the shared drive? Speaker 1: The one dated yesterday. The older one has the wrong wavelength table. Speaker 2: Got it. And the reviewers' second point, about the detector temperature, is that in your section or mine? Speaker 1: Mine, but I need your logs from the cold run to answer it. They don't have to be cleaned. Speaker 2: Fine, they're on the instrument laptop. I'll copy them over with the config. Speaker 1: Thanks. Also, the reading group is ours to choose this month. Speaker 2: I'll pick a paper for the reading group. Something on the new calibration methods, maybe. Speaker 1: Something short, please; people actually read the short ones. Speaker 1: And I need to tell you something strictly confidential. I've filed a harassment complaint against the lab head, and HR has opened an investigation. Nobody else in the group knows, and I'd like to keep it that way until it's resolved. I'm telling you because I may be out of some meetings he chairs. Speaker 2: Thank you for trusting me. It stays with me, and I'll cover anything you need in those meetings. Speaker 1: Thank you. That means a lot. Back to the paper, then: the deadline for the revision is still the 30th? Speaker 2: The 30th, yes. If your section is in by Monday and mine by Wednesday, we have a week for the figures and the response letter. Speaker 1: That's tight but fine. The figure with the flare spectra needs new error bars, by the way. Speaker 2: I'll redo the error bars once the fits are rerun with the new config. Speaker 1: Great. I think that's everything. Thanks again for listening.
